about: Measured from a screen recording of the Sinking Swing rebuilt in bonk.io (Nov 2026), 60 fps, scaled to 947 px wide: one ball's radius is 26 px here (20 px in our game). Per frame: ball [x, y, radius], floor (top edge y), planks [[x, y, angle from vertical in degrees]...], rope (angle from straight down, degrees, + = seat to the right; from the frame the ball lands on).
